notes: This record covers only the newly announced Digit 5 generation (Sept 2026). Its specs (height/weight/payload/battery) are manufacturer claims for early access targeted H1 2027; no shipped or demonstrated evidence exists yet for this generation.

The prior generation's named, operating deployments (Ford 2020, GXO 2023-2024) are a different hardware generation and are tracked separately as agility-digit-gen4, so shipped status is never implied for a generation that has not shipped.

Digit is sold as Robots-as-a-Service, not a one-time purchase, so price_history is intentionally empty — no credible per-unit or subscription price was located from a manufacturer source during this build.

actuator_torque_nm, battery_wh, battery_swappable, sdk, warranty, and order_type were left out (2026-09-21): the Digit 5 announcement discloses only the 90-min/9-min runtime-and-charge figures and 'proprietary cycloidal actuator technology' without an Nm value, and directs buyers to a sales/quote page ('Deploy Digit') without a literal, quotable ordering-model or warranty statement.

locomotion left out (2026-09-21): agilityrobotics.com/solutions/digit-5, the Sept 2026 Digit 5 press release, IEEE Spectrum's coverage, and Agility's general Digit page were all checked; each describes leg joints, reach, or general humanoid-robot history in a bipedal category, but none gave a literal sentence stating Digit 5 itself is bipedal/two-legged. Left out rather than reused from the gen4 record's Amazon-newsroom quote, which covers a different hardware generation.
